none: PAS NLM-BD7DA2: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Emperor right issue, Reece period 19. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Obverse inscription: [DN] VALE[--]. Reverse description: Emperor standing right holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: GLORIA RO [MANORVM]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.8mm, Weight: 1.78gms, die axis: 6
